## Deferrals read

- **D-P30.3-2** — this ticket owns the engineering half (tippecanoe z0–z14
  per-compartment PMTiles, island on tiles, repo-owned nginx compression + the first
  repo-owned `sig-web` deploy path, **no basemap** per Q8, `/map/points.json` retired
  per Q9). The public half — the live map drawing tiles, `points.json` verified gone —
  stays OPEN → **P31.16**.
- **R8-1** (ACCEPT-R8) — the combined `/map/points.json` operator-ACCEPTED deviation is
  recorded **ENDING** here: the build no longer emits it and the island no longer
  fetches it. The live object stops being served at P31.16's republish, which closes it.
- **CROSS-CUTTING INVARIANTS** re-checked: ODbL compartment separation (per-compartment
  archives, per-source attribution); tier-0/§19.4 coordinate rules (tiles render the
  already-published reduced points only); zero-JS public pages (the `/map` island
  allowance only); SHA-tagged images never `:latest`; no third-party runtime requests
  (no basemap service — Q8); secrets env-only; append-only spine (untouched); no
  merge/tag/push-main.
- **OUT OF SCOPE** re-checked: no hosted re-export, no republish, no `sig-web` roll
  (P31.16), no analytics changes (P31.14), no self-hosted OSM extract, no third-party
  tile service.

## Requirements (from the spec)

1. **Tippecanoe in the export image** — a pinned version via a multi-stage build (or a
   separate tile-build job), recorded in ADR-R9-TILES. Per-compartment PMTiles z0–z14,
   attribution embedded, deterministic for a snapshot. The pure-Python fallback remains
   for CI.
2. **Island on tiles** — `/map` layers the per-compartment archives (attribution per
   layer in `style.json`); zero-JS fallback (static map) unchanged; public content pages
   keep zero `<script>`.
3. **Compression** — repo-owned nginx config for `sig-web` (gzip + brotli if available)
   for JSON/CSS/HTML/SVG, correct `Content-Type` + range support for PMTiles, plus the
   first repo-owned `sig-web` deploy path (image built from it, deployed by pinned
   digest via `pin_image_digest`; the live hand-made config — gcsfuse mount, env,
   ingress — read live and reproduced). Built + tested here; **P31.16 rolls it**.
4. **Basemap (Q8 = none)** — nothing built or referenced; the style keeps the plain
   background; (b) self-hosted extract recorded as a costed follow-up in the ADR;
   (c) third-party service never.
5. **Combined `points.json` (Q9 = retire)** — island no longer fetches it; the build no
   longer emits it; zero-JS static map unaffected; R8-1 recorded ending (closed at
   P31.16).
6. **Tests** — tile builder z-range + attribution; island reads tiles (web unit test);
   nginx config linted; lighthouse budgets hold.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Per-compartment PMTiles carry z0–z14 with attribution; deterministic (test).
- [x] Island draws from tiles; content pages zero `<script>`; lighthouse + WCAG green.
- [x] nginx compression config in repo + tested; `sig-web` deploy plan digest-pinned.
- [x] Q8/Q9 recorded in ADR-R9-TILES (`## Revisit trigger` + Appendix F row);
      D-P30.3-2 note (surface half → P31.16).

## Plan

- `exports/src/exports/tiles.py`: promote the pure-Python renderer to a real z0–z14
  pyramid (Hilbert tile ids, delta-encoded multi-entry directory, gzip'd MVT tiles);
  tippecanoe path `-Z0 -z14` + a deterministic `sig:license` metadata annotation pass;
  `_render_tiles` slims feature properties to the render set (entity_id, label,
  jurisdiction, tier, precision).
- `ops/Dockerfile`: multi-stage tippecanoe build from a sha256-verified 2.79.0 source
  tarball; stale "min-instances 0" header corrected.
- `web/`: `map-tiles.ts` drops the never-built basemap source (Q8) and the contract
  becomes per-compartment; `map.astro`/`MapIsland.tsx` draw the per-compartment
  `pmtiles://` sources (fixtures mode keeps a small inline geojson fallback);
  `map/points.json.ts` + the payload codec deleted (Q9); tests updated.
- `ops/web/`: `nginx.conf` (gzip for JSON/CSS/HTML/SVG; brotli compiled as a dynamic
  module in the image — Alpine's prebuilt module is ABI-mismatched, verified) +
  `Dockerfile` (pinned `nginx:1.27-alpine` digest) + `ops/gcp/web.sh` deploy path
  (`pin_image_digest`; live-read service spec reproduced) +
  `tests/ops/test_web_iac.py`.
- ADR-118 (ADR-R9-TILES) + Appendix F row + spec rebuild + BL-056 sources +
  DEFERRALS/ACCEPT-R8 annotations.
